title: agentforce-action-reviewer inputs
description: Typed inputs for the agentforce-action-reviewer runtime agent. Machine-readable mirror of the Inputs table in AGENT.md. The harness validates caller-supplied input packets against this schema before the agent begins work; validation failures surface the offending field to the caller rather than failing mid-run.

agent_metadata_path.description: Path to the DX package directory holding the retrieved Agentforce metadata — bots/, genAiPlannerBundles/, genAiPlugins/, genAiFunctions/. This is the agent's only data surface: there is no MCP probe for Agentforce metadata, and the library's own get_agent tool returns SfSkills AGENT.md bodies, not org agents.

agent_developer_name.description: Developer name of the agent to review; selects which Bot / GenAiPlannerBundle under agent_metadata_path is in scope when the directory holds more than one.

target_org_alias.description: Optional. Used only to resolve the Apex classes and Flows behind actions (get_apex_class, list_flows_on_object). The review runs without it; omitting it caps confidence at MEDIUM because action implementations are then unread.

review_depth.description: topic_only scores Topic coherence and guardrails alone; per_action additionally scores every GenAiFunction on the eight Step 2 dimensions.
